title: Glass Choir at 3AM
description: A melody-led future-garage cut: a bright bell-arp lead trades phrases with chopped diva-number stabs over a shuffled LinnDrum breakbeat. Lush sidechained pads pump under broken kicks, the groove climbs to two euphoric peaks split by a hushed valley, then strips back to a delay-soaked outro.

setcpm(130/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(6000),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).lpf(1400).gain(0.55).room(0.3).delay(".3:.18:.5")
